title: Net debt / EBITDA refuses closed on a negative EBITDA denominator
note: net_debt_to_ebitda = (total_debt - cash_and_bank) / ebitda. ebitda is negative (-5), and a negative denominator makes the ratio's sign meaningless as a leverage multiple, so the formula refuses with SIGN_MEANINGLESS_DENOMINATOR rather than returning a negative multiple that would read as deleveraged.
